purpose: Externalize rough spatial design intent as a deterministic sketch and give human, script, AI, or machine builders ruler/straightedge/spacing/square/level/symmetry/caliper-style evidence while they construct against that plan.

properties.operation: inspect-workshop, validate-sketch, compare-sketch, measure-design, or materialize-sketch
properties.sketch: axm.design-sketch/v0.1 rough blockout with exact rigid part frames, sizes, gauges and tolerances
properties.observation: axm.design-workshop-observation/v0.1 exact caller-observed part frames/sizes bound to the sketch digest
properties.path: ordinary creation path for sketch.json plus schematic sketch.svg
properties.replace: optional explicit boolean replacement for materialization

contains: distance, alignment, spacing, angle, orientation, symmetry and size gauge evidence
optional schematic front/top/side SVG paired with exact sketch JSON

relationships: sits beside Design Fabric as a pre-build/blockout and during-build measurement surface
lets the machine externalize rough spatial intent instead of relying only on language or hidden context
returns numeric residuals that can feed later repair planning without silently applying a repair

anatomy_refs.basis: Keeps rough visual-spatial intent explicit while separating schematic intent from final rendering evidence.
Observed construction state is digest-bound to the exact sketch before numeric comparison.

limitations: sketch parts are bounded simple shape/frame/size intent, not final mesh geometry
schematic SVG projection does not rasterize rotated extents and never replaces exact frame data
measurements compare caller-supplied frames and sizes; no camera/screenshot inference is performed
PASS does not prove mesh fit, collision clearance, strength, manufacturability, physics, semantics, aesthetics or target-engine quality

truth.basis: Every measurement reports explicit numeric residuals against declared tolerances and unobserved parts HOLD instead of being guessed.

agency.basis: The caller owns sketch intent, gauges, tolerances, observations, materialization and any later repair decision.

continuity.basis: Sketch and observation are bound by exact digests; materialized projects retain the canonical sketch body.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Malformed gauges, unknown parts, digest drift and unsupported evidence are rejected rather than converted into approximate truth.
